stations.title: Imran
stations.say: Can the phones send the readings?
stations.note: The board in the shed gets wiped.

stations.title: Volunteer's phone
stations.text: Has the litres, and nowhere to send them.

stations.title: Imran
stations.say: So that is what north has used.

captions: At Marrowfield, Imran wants the evening meter readings sent from the volunteers' phones.
Today they go on a board in the shed, and half of them are wiped before he copies them.
You write a server that reads JSON bodies, checks them and answers in JSON, in four tasks.
Now the north tap's reading reaches the laptop and is kept, and broken ones are refused.
Same evening round, no board. Imran asks the server for each tap's total.
